update.foreach: update portal_auth_center.org_tree set short_name=#{item.shortName}, node_type=#{item.nodeType}, exist_type=#{item.existType}, node_category=#{item.nodeCategory}, parent_id=#{item.parentId}, id_path=#{item.idPath}, show_order=#{item.showOrder}, relate_id=#{item.relateId}, update_time=#{item.updateTime}, update_user='0' where id = #{item.id}

mapper.insert:
insert into portal_auth_center.org_tree(id, node_name, short_name, node_type, exist_type, node_category, parent_id, id_path, show_order, tenant_id, relate_id, create_user, update_user) values
(#{item.id}, #{item.nodeName}, #{item.shortName}, #{item.nodeType}, #{item.existType}, #{item.nodeCategory}, #{item.parentId}, #{item.idPath}, #{item.showOrder}, #{item.tenantId}, #{item.relateId}, '0', '0')
mapper.select: select id as item_id, phone as item_name from portal_auth_center.sys_user where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and delete_time = 0
mapper.insert:
insert into portal_auth_center.sys_user(id, phone, account, real_name, passwd, email, src_type, src_id, tenant_id, create_user, update_user) values
(#{u.id}, #{u.phone}, #{u.account}, #{u.realName}, #{u.passwd}, #{u.email}, #{u.srcType}, #{u.srcId}, #{u.tenantId}, '0', '0')
on duplicate key update phone = values(phone), account = values(account), real_name = values(real_name), email = values(email), src_type = values(src_type), src_id = values(src_id), update_user = '0', update_time = now()

insert ignore into portal_auth_center.user_org(id, user_id, org_id, node_id, tenant_id, main_job, create_user, update_user, update_time) values
(#{uo.id}, #{uo.userId}, #{uo.orgId}, #{uo.nodeId}, #{uo.tenantId}, #{uo.mainJob}, '0', '0', #{uo.updateTime})
on duplicate key update main_job=values(main_job), update_user = '0', update_time = values(update_time)
